notes.title: v1.3.2 Changelog
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added option to toggle between full screen and windowed video modes.
[*]Fixed audio issue that could occur when transitioning to a new song.
[*]Made intro cinema music fade when transitioning to the gameplay state.
[*]Fixed aspect ratio constraints not working properly for some window sizes.
[*]Added loading icon to startup screen.
[*]Upgraded to the latest Steamworks SDK.
[/list]
